Decide one direction-tier question for the existing ACVC Convergence node: does the concrete native link-loss mapping below justify one bounded new-host B/EXPLORE comparison, or should ACVC retain its current boundary with no successor? I narrowly recommend the comparison. The native reward and inherited 1/4 return-unit meaning need an explicit answer; I have not locally reopened a family or selected a scientific object. P76 authorizes question preparation only. Give a class-correct direction decision, not a new planning assignment or a request for an exact headroom prerequisite.

Read the preparation intake sections 1-4 and computed facts first. Preserve R03 HC-C: the exact bound 0.2139371014275 < 1/4 closes the unchanged uncertain/delayed host as a learner-investment target. R02's legal history gain 0.022197511111 and positive legal action witness remain. All original thresholds/envelope and no-rescue boundaries remain. This is an independently existing five-UAV native service environment, already used by UCOPE/MGTAP/VSPC1, not a retuned R01 simulator. Current ACTIVE/MEDIUM, recasts 2 and lowest sequencing remain Portfolio/owner facts; this request selects none of those dispositions.

The missing P68 mapping is now concrete from actual source. Native observation rows contain relative user XY and SINR, not user IDs; they include at most 20 eligible users sorted by SINR. At t-1 retain only the lowest-SINR nonpadding observed user, bound by its static reconstructed coordinate, own UAV, observation time and actual own motion. If at t the user list is unsaturated and that anchor is absent under an unambiguous FP32-scale coordinate match, its own link is below the 3 dB eligibility threshold. It is not merely a sorting/truncation change. Skip saturated, ambiguous, empty or reset cases. A source-only information example is a currently invisible user previously west rather than east: an identical eastward proposal should face a different correction opportunity. This is not an enumerated positive-probability trace or a measured reward witness. Own-link loss is not proof of global service loss: teammates can add interference or take over service. No actor receives global user IDs, current service assignment, full SINR, other current commands, a teammate's private history or a newly supplied reward observation.

Each UAV's shared frozen DENSE base proposes b_t. On the unambiguous loss cue, and only if that proposal points horizontally away from the remembered anchor, a gate can instead choose c_t=(own previous position-own current position)/(30 m/s*1 s). This legally retraces the actually realized preceding displacement, with normal rounding-scale action clipping. Both positions are private permitted observations. Partners still move, so the correction does not guarantee restoration of SINR or service. Outside the cue all policies apply b_t. Only one previous anchor is retained; no all-user history census, policy search or future rollout is needed.

Use the first listed completed MGTAP P75 DENSE/8201 final checkpoint as the identical fully frozen motion proposer in all arms. Its bytes exist, SHA256 f648f2b100d07335ccd9c79c0476b8e9dba0c1644ae837d622b0c5f711030790, and were checked without a tensor load. It is a trained reachable control with original J 0.1922357063 versus hover 0.1478473820; DENSE/8202 was 0.1687618179 versus hover 0.1413671718. Both outcomes were known at selection: the new comparison is conditional on one outcome-informed fixed base, not a newly tuned baseline or independent generalization claim. The accepted source surfaces match current input. Pro need not access the binary to decide this question.

Proposed policies: C always applies the base; F always retraces on the cue; T trains a private recurrent Bernoulli gate with an explicit bound-anchor path and the same raw private history; G retains T's entire trainable path and adds an unconstrained dense residual from those same raw inputs to the gate logit. G receives every derived feature T receives and contains T when the residual is zero, which is its proposed initial output. Shared components start identically. C/F are constant gate choices available to both. There is no information advantage for T, no weakened generic learner budget and no assertion that SGD must attain the contained functions. Exact small gate head sizes are a later card detail. Each arm's frozen base keeps its own recurrence on its actual trajectory; never share another arm's hidden state. Train only gate and critic. No model or master is created now.

The primary native comparison reports T-C and T-F separately, with T minus the better fixed panel mean as a transparent summary, not hidden comparator selection. T-G is mandatory for the structured-versus-containing-generic claim; retain G-C and G-F and every arm's native value. Positive T-G cannot rescue a native loss to C/F. If both learned gates beat the fixed rules but G contains the gain, at most a learned correction package is supported; do not claim ACVC structure superiority. Within-margin is not equivalence. Sparse gate opportunities or actor movement limit the learning claim even if critic updates are nonzero. All five private gates co-adapt; a local cue or action count alone is not native value. This is not a unique information/representation/credit causal attribution experiment.

The existing evaluator already reports S=sum of the unchanged native team rewards and J=S/256. Keep both. Proposed new-host MEI is 0.01 J=2.56 S, chosen as a meaningful one-percentage-point average native improvement for a small next investment, not a universal number. I propose interpreting the archived new-host '1/4 native-return headroom' in raw episode S, equivalent to 0.0009765625 J, but this is NOT adopted locally. Explicitly decide whether that reading is faithful to your inherited condition. If instead the inherited condition means 0.25 J, the present source evidence does not support expecting that large average gain; do not silently lower it or declare it satisfied. Retain the boundary if this concrete mapping does not meet the preserved scientific purpose. If you identify a specification conflict, name the exact rule and scope rather than invent an implicit exception.

The low-confidence positive mechanism expectation in S is that the learned gate can avoid blind F retraces during useful handoffs while correcting real net service losses relative to C. Eighteen extra served-user time steps contribute 18*0.7/50=0.252 through the native coverage term. This is scale arithmetic only: the average connected-link quality, motion and partner response can erase or reverse it. No observed gain is claimed. There is no tuned upper-minus-generic headroom record on this host; computing an exact maximum, tuning a baseline or buying a positive measurement before B is not proposed. Apply evidence-spec sections 11.8 and 11.9 to the selected question itself, not only its implementation.

Prospective minimal work is one newly trained matched instance, two gate/critic arms, each 512 complete 256-step episodes, 256 two-episode rollouts and four Adam calls per rollout; final checkpoint only, 32 paired episodes each for T/G/C/F. This is 294912 native steps, 2048 Adam calls, 512 rollouts, 1152 explicit resets and 128 final evaluation episodes. It is one training instance, not 32 or 128 independent training samples. Preserve every per-arm outcome and conditional episode uncertainty; no stable population claim. Frozen base work is 1474560 agent forwards; learned gate forward work is at most 1392640. Prospective row matching was reduced before implementation from all 20 previous rows (573440000 coordinate pairs) to one anchor (28672000 upper bound); C needs no matching. No nested candidates, trajectories, exact support census or solver calls remain. These are intrinsic algorithm costs, not added validation. New gate opportunities, displacement, wall and RSS are unknown.

P75's separate pair timings 353.71 and 368.12 seconds are reference facts, not new-runtime forecasts. Proposed caps are 1800 seconds per complete learned arm and 3600 seconds for the complete study including initialization, C/F evaluation, focused checks and publication, all unallocated. Reconsider the question if its cost defeats it; do not add a pilot, higher cap, hidden phases or parallel machinery. A later portable exact-commit run would use the current remote_first route and fresh node-local resource admission. This proposal needs none of engineering-scope section 4's added machinery; existing checkpoint input loading is not recovery orchestration. One focused changed-path/primary check is sufficient unless a concrete correctness gap requires more.

Contrary evidence is explicit: MGTAP REL-DENSE was -0.0446825 and -0.00324368; VSPC1's two 768 endpoints were negative, latest -0.01353496. They are different scientific comparisons and are not pooled with ACVC. P68's targeted literature grounding is reused only as an adjacent information/action lesson; the present mapping comes from native source. No paper establishes this UAV mechanism or novelty. No broad library retrieval is needed. A fixed rule or the generic gate containing all useful behavior is the strongest alternative to ACVC-specific value.

Machine-generated consultation exposure line: P76 new scientific invocations=0; model instantiations/imports=0; native steps=0; optimizer updates=0; evaluation episodes=0; counterfactual probes=0. Proposed gate exposure remains unmeasured. Prior DENSE relative actor displacement 0.2409414873 is historical competence evidence, not new gate exposure.
